user.title: Pit Lane Live Board
user.description:
Formula 1 in a ready-made sidebar panel: live timing, calendar, results since 1950 and both championships.

Pit Lane Live Board is unofficial and is not associated in any way with the Formula 1 companies. F1, FORMULA ONE, FORMULA 1, FIA FORMULA ONE WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP, GRAND PRIX and related marks are trade marks of Formula One Licensing B.V.

Results and standings data: Jolpica-F1 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Live data: F1's public live timing, for personal, non-commercial use.

f1tv_new_token.title: F1TV needs a new token
f1tv_new_token.description:
Pit Lane Live Board could not renew your F1TV token: the F1TV login behind it has ended, or F1 refused the renewal. Everything keeps working except the live track map.

To bring the map back, sign in to F1TV in your browser, copy a new token and paste it under Settings → Devices & services → Pit Lane Live Board → Configure. The guide shows each step.

live_unreachable.title: Live timing unreachable
live_unreachable.description:
The last three session windows ended without a single connection to F1's live timing. F1 may have changed or closed the feed, or this Home Assistant cannot reach livetiming.formula1.com.

Calendar, results and standings keep working. Check the diagnostics of Pit Lane Live Board and the project's issues for news; this notice clears itself after the next successful connection.
